metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Minimal Core (v1.2)
metadata.description: Minimal machine-native core of Framework Field Theory containing foundational types, one regime, one invariant, and clarity/harmonic operator definitions compatible with the full AI Edition v1.2 stack.

field.signal.description: Canonical signal type used as input for clarity, coherence, drift, and paradox operators.

metric.clarity.description: Canonical clarity metric output type. Represents the computed clarity value of a given signal.

metric.harmonic.description: Harmonic paradox metric output type used during RTT12 harmonic escalation.

regimes.name: Resonance-Time Core Regime
regimes.description: Primary temporal-structural regime governing clarity, coherence, drift, and paradox handling.

regimes.name: Harmonic Resonance Regime
regimes.description: Regime activated during harmonic paradox escalation (RTT12).

invariants.name: Declared Coherence Under Bounded Drift
invariants.description: System must maintain declared coherence while drift remains bounded within the resonance-time regime.

operators.name: Spectral Clarity Operator
operators.description: Computes clarity metric for a given signal under declared coherence and bounded drift.

operators.name: Harmonic Analysis Operator
operators.description: Evaluates harmonic paradox interactions during RTT12 escalation.

compatibility.notes: Core provides minimal primitives required by all higher layers in the AI Edition v1.2 stack.
